name: Employee API CI/CD


on:

  push:

    branches:
      - main


  pull_request:

    branches:
      - main



jobs:


  build-test:


    runs-on: ubuntu-latest


    steps:


    # 1. Checkout Code
    - name: Checkout Source Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4



    # 2. Setup Java
    - name: Setup Java 17
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4

      with:

        java-version: '17'

        distribution: 'temurin'

        cache: maven



    # 3. Maven Build

    - name: Build Application

      run: |

        mvn clean package



    # 4. Unit Testing

    - name: Run Tests

      run: |

        mvn test



    # 5. SonarQube Analysis

    - name: SonarQube Scan

      run: |

        mvn sonar:sonar \
        -Dsonar.projectKey=employee-api \
        -Dsonar.host.url=${{ secrets.SONAR_URL }} \
        -Dsonar.login=${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}



    # 6. Docker Login

    - name: Login Docker Hub

      uses: docker/login-action@v3

      with:

        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}

        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}



    # 7. Build Docker Image

    - name: Docker Build

      run: |

        docker build \
        -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/employee-api:v1 .



    # 8. Push Docker Image

    - name: Docker Push

      run: |

        docker push \
        ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/employee-api:v1
